observations.note: Step 8 says to write all completed marks in one plan edit, but the session made five separate Edit calls, one per row, after a first failed attempt at turn 15.
No search of the spec folders for behaviours touched by the changed source files (step 7) is visible before the rows were marked, though the truncated final note may have covered it.

conformance.item: Procedure 1: read plan rows and triage note first
Procedure 3: tests first, fail for the right reason
Procedure 4: code rows changed in the named files
Procedure 6: run only the phase's test files, as plain commands
Procedure 7: check specs the change touches that the plan does not name
Procedure 8: write the completed marks in one edit
Limits: no commit, push or gh; change only the plan's marks
What to hand over: phase_note ARTIFACT line
